significance: One of the older Shiva temples of the Coimbatore region, credited to Chola kings and reckoned over 1,300 years old, with a self-manifested linga and a second linga in the sanctum. It is administered by the Tamil Nadu Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments Department.
story: Sundaramurthy Nayanar is said to have been fed here by an old couple who then revealed themselves as Shiva and Parvati; because the god offered virundhu, a feast, he is called Virundeeswarar.
